station-02.title: Halocline mixing break
station-02.hypothesis:
A salinity hinge at33psu tests a fixed physically interpretable freshwater/halocline compartment break.

Development feedback available before this hypothesis: [{"attempt": "attempt-001", "group_MAE": 0.06957232562423508, "worst_group": 0.09173675149858355}, {"attempt": "attempt-002", "group_MAE": 0.08255974042557099, "worst_group": 0.10476368110522996}]

This attempt tests a distinct explanation/ablation. All reserved groups remain unscored. A failure to beat the incumbent rejects predictive benefit rather than proving absence of the underlying physical process.

Decision rationale: Depth-only underperforms salinity/temperature, but thermal extension worsens one cast. Test a fixed halocline break for multiple mixing regimes.
